messages:
Noah: Heads-upfamily in town this Sat, looking for brunch near Redwood office (Market & 5th). Kid-friendly + a few vegetarian options. Open by 9am?
Ivy: @Noah Try The Nook on Mission. Cozy, lots of veggie pancakes and a kids menu. Opens at 8:30.
Sam: The Nook is great. Also Sunny Side Cafe (by the ferry) has a playground across the street and GF pancakes on request.
Jules: If you want something quieter, Quiet Spoon opens at 9 and has table service with kids plates.
Kei: Quick poll: The Nook :pancakes:, Sunny Side (playground) :child:, Quiet Spoon (calm) :tea:. Drop an emoji.
Noah: Vote: The Nook :white_check_mark: (thanks folks!)
Ivy: I can swing by at 8:30 and save a table if you want.
Noah: That would be ace, Ivy. Please save a high chair if possible.
Ivy: On it  called and left a note for Noah party of 4 at 8:30 Sat. Confirm #N-442.
Noah: Huge, thank you everyone :heart:
